def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids); types = list(feats.types)
    S = sorted(set(feats.stratum)); st = np.array(feats.stratum)
    B = np.column_stack([np.ones(n)] + [(st == s).astype(float) for s in S[1:]])
    R = np.corrcoef(X, rowvar=False); R = np.nan_to_num(R)
    def fit(Z):
        A = np.column_stack([B] + ([Z] if Z is not None and Z.size else []))
        w = np.zeros(A.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            pr = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(A @ w, -30, 30)))
            H = A.T @ (A * (pr * (1 - pr))[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(A.shape[1])
            d = np.linalg.solve(H, A.T @ (y - pr)); w += d
            if np.abs(d).max() < 1e-7: break
        pr = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-A @ w)), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(pr) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - pr))), pr
    ll = lambda Z: fit(Z)[0]
    M = lambda js, extra=None: np.column_stack([X[:, js]] + ([extra] if extra is not None else [])) if js or extra is not None else None
    deg = (np.abs(R) >= 0.6).sum(0) - 1
    hubs = [j for j in np.argsort(-deg)[:3] if types[j] == 'clinical' and deg[j] >= 3]
    def ctx(sel, j): return [h for h in hubs if h != j and h not in sel and all(abs(R[h, k]) < 0.6 for k in sel + [j])]
    def gain(sel, j):
        c = sel + ctx(sel, j); return 2 * (ll(M(c + [j])) - ll(M(c)))
    thr = lambda a: stats.chi2.isf(a, 1)
    sel = []
    for step in range(MAX_DRIVERS):
        cand = [j for j in range(p) if j not in sel and all(abs(R[j, k]) < 0.6 for k in sel)]
        if not cand: break
        g = {j: gain(sel, j) for j in cand}; b = max(g, key=g.get)
        if g[b] < thr((0.01 if step == 0 else 0.1) / p): break
        cl = [j for j in g if abs(R[b, j]) >= 0.6 and g[j] >= g[b] - 2] + [b]
        if len(set(cl)) > 1:
            def tot(j): return sum(max(gain(sel + [j], k), 0) for k in set(cl) if k != j)
            b = min(set(cl), key=tot)
        sel.append(b)
    while len(sel) > 1:
        gs = {j: 2 * (ll(M(sel)) - ll(M([k for k in sel if k != j]))) for j in sel}
        w = min(gs, key=gs.get)
        if gs[w] >= thr(0.1 / p): break
        sel.remove(w)
    base = sel + ([h for h in hubs if all(abs(R[h, k]) < 0.6 for k in sel)] if sel else [])
    l0 = ll(M(base)); prs = [(a, b) for a in range(p) for b in range(a, p)]
    pr0 = fit(M(base))[1]
    P = np.column_stack([X[:, a] * X[:, b] for a, b in prs]); P = (P - P.mean(0)) / (P.std(0) + 1e-9)
    sc = (P.T @ (y - pr0)) ** 2 / ((P ** 2).T @ (pr0 * (1 - pr0)) + 1e-9)
    prods = []
    for i in np.argsort(-sc)[:15]:
        a, b = prs[i]; js = sorted(set(base + [a, b]))
        if 2 * (ll(M(js, P[:, [i]])) - ll(M(js))) >= thr(0.005 / len(prs)):
            if not any({a, b} & set(q) for q in prods): prods.append((a, b))
        if len(prods) >= 2: break
    for a, b in prods:
        for j in (a, b):
            if j not in base: base.append(j)
    drv = sel + [j for q in prods for j in q if j not in sel]
    drv = [ids[j] for j in dict.fromkeys(drv)][:MAX_DRIVERS]
    if not drv: return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drv), columns=tuple(ids[j] for j in base),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[b]) for a, b in prods), loadings={})
